title: Airy Aerated Slovakian Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish with a twist, featuring aerated pork dumplings in a briny gochujang sauce, perfect for meal prep. This kosher-friendly recipe is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork shoulder, gochujang, salt, and black pepper, and mix until just combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and eggs.
Add the dry ingredients to the pork mixture and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat and fry the dumplings until they are golden brown.
Remove the dumplings from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the dumplings hot with a side of steamed vegetables or a salad.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
